n7208ced74d.headline: Inside negotiation rooms: A first-time observer’s notes from finance talks in Baku
n7208ced74d.summary: An observer's account describes late-night plenary sessions in Baku, Azerbaijan, on November 24, 2024, where delegates and journalists awaited a key outcome. The article covers the finance talks.
n7208ced74d.why: Climate finance negotiations determine how much public and private capital flows to developing countries for climate adaptation and mitigation.

n188cc66308.headline: Barrick’s buccaneering boss tested as Mali squeezes gold miners
n188cc66308.summary: Barrick Gold chief Mark Bristow is being pressed by Mali's junta, which is desperate for cash, after decades of building major African gold mines. The report contrasts this with the 2012 border arrangement that favoured Randgold employees.
n188cc66308.why: Barrick Gold is one of the world's largest gold miners, so government pressure in host countries directly affects its output, costs and revenue.

ne1e6a392d5.headline: Landline Internet prices soar by 27% or more
ne1e6a392d5.summary: Telecom Egypt has raised prices for its home internet packages, including Mega and Ultra plans. The new prices include 14 percent value added tax.
ne1e6a392d5.why: Telecom Egypt is the country's main fixed-line operator, so its pricing changes affect household spending and the company's revenue.

n019056f5e7.headline: Eastnine's major shareholder has sold a block of shares at a 7 percent discount
n019056f5e7.summary: Warsaw Unit, a subsidiary of the Ghelamco Group, sold 7.1 million Eastnine shares through a placement. The shares were sold to Swedish and other investors at a 7% discount.
n019056f5e7.why: Eastnine is a Stockholm-listed real estate company, and large shareholder sales at a discount can weigh on its share price.

nccdf6d258d.headline: Charlotte Tilbury owner Puig shares dip after withdrawing make-up setting spray
nccdf6d258d.summary: Barcelona-based Puig told shareholders it expects the withdrawal of a make-up setting spray to affect its cosmetics business. Its shares dipped on the news.
nccdf6d258d.why: Puig is a Spanish fashion and beauty group that owns the Charlotte Tilbury brand, and cosmetics is a major part of its revenue.

n26825a9ee1.headline: Australian regulator moves to curtail criminal use of cryptocurrency
n26825a9ee1.summary: Australia's financial crime monitoring agency set up an internal cryptocurrency task force. It will target crypto ATM providers that do not comply with anti-money laundering laws.
n26825a9ee1.why: AUSTRAC is Australia's financial intelligence and AML regulator, and its rules govern crypto exchanges and ATM operators.

n560951fb4e.headline: Govt-to-Govt fuel procurement strategy gains traction as Chakwera engages UAE for long-term solutions | Nyasa Times
n560951fb4e.summary: Malawi's President Lazarus Chakwera is in the United Arab Emirates negotiating a long-lasting fuel supply arrangement. The government-to-government procurement strategy aims to secure the country's energy future.
n560951fb4e.why: Government-to-government fuel contracts can stabilise supply and pricing for import-dependent African economies.

source.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

sources.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

nbb5c912329.headline: Nigeria Secures $50m Loan To Boost Women-Owned Businesses
nbb5c912329.summary: The Bank of Industry has secured a $50 million loan portfolio from the African Guarantee Fund to empower women entrepreneurs. The framework is backed by the African Development Bank's Affirmative Finance Action for Women in Africa.
nbb5c912329.why: The Bank of Industry is a Nigerian development lender, and guarantee-backed credit lines expand financing for small businesses.

ne4c86cd397.headline: Alumil's comeback and the next day
ne4c86cd397.summary: Greek aluminium company Alumil is staging a comeback, less than 1.5 years after a conflict with its servicers that caused tremors in investor confidence.
ne4c86cd397.why: Alumil is a Greek manufacturer of aluminium building systems listed in Athens. Disputes with debt servicers can affect investor confidence in listed industrial companies.

n1e3a89aa9a.headline: Biden’s Last-Minute African Trip Leaves Trump With Fertile Ground, Say Analysts
n1e3a89aa9a.summary: Analysts say Biden's Angola investments gave the United States a strong foothold in mineral-rich southern Africa, a move that would concern China, regional experts said.
n1e3a89aa9a.why: Angola is a major oil producer and holds mineral resources that matter for global supply chains. Competition between the US and China over Africa's resources affects investment and trade flows.

n9d58e233b4.headline: Prabowo forges cooperation with 20 Japanese businesses
n9d58e233b4.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto secured several cooperation commitments from 20 Japanese businesspeople from the Jakarta Japan Club, including in strategic energy.
n9d58e233b4.why: Japanese investment in Indonesia spans energy, manufacturing and infrastructure, so new cooperation commitments can shape future capital flows into the country.

n0f7df4841d.headline: Eles buys back 31,000 of its own ordinary shares for EUR45,000
n0f7df4841d.summary: Eles Spa bought back 31,000 of its ordinary shares between December 2 and 6 at an average price of EUR1.45, for a total of about EUR45,000.
n0f7df4841d.why: Share buybacks reduce the number of shares outstanding and are a routine capital-allocation tool for listed companies.

n6652f170fa.headline: Balearics’ housing burden
n6652f170fa.summary: Residents of the Balearic Islands dedicate a higher share of their income to housing than anywhere else in Spain. The report highlights the region's housing affordability strain.
n6652f170fa.why: Housing costs shape household spending, wage pressure and property-market demand, which affect real estate, banks and consumer-linked sectors.

nf85b35849b.headline: Fitch revises Hungary's outlook to 'stable'
nf85b35849b.summary: Fitch on Friday revised its outlook on Hungary to stable from negative. The agency cited a reduction in macroeconomic imbalances driven by improved coherence between fiscal and monetary policy.
nf85b35849b.why: Sovereign credit ratings and outlooks influence borrowing costs for governments, the value of their bonds and the currency.

n624d6d0570.headline: Monetary policy reforms, unification of FX rates yielding results, says Shettima
n624d6d0570.summary: Vice-President Kashim Shettima said monetary policy reforms and the unification of foreign exchange rates are yielding positive results for Nigeria.
n624d6d0570.why: Exchange-rate unification and monetary reforms affect currency stability, foreign investor confidence and inflation in Nigeria.

n2a762fd95b.headline: OECD Report: Greek Real Estate Prices Have Soared 69% Since 2017
n2a762fd95b.summary: An OECD report shows Greek housing prices rose 69% since 2017, with nearly 27% of households spending over 40% of income on housing.
n2a762fd95b.why: The OECD is a Paris-based group of advanced economies that publishes widely used economic and housing data.

nf76164139f.headline: Zambia : Mozambique Unrest Affects Fuel Supply In Zambia
nf76164139f.summary: Zambia's Energy Regulation Board says fuel shortages in some parts of the country are due to unrest in Mozambique.
nf76164139f.why: Zambia imports much of its fuel through regional routes, so disruptions in neighbouring countries affect local supply.

source.name: Lusaka Times-Zambia's Leading Online News Site - LusakaTimes.com

sources.name: Lusaka Times-Zambia's Leading Online News Site - LusakaTimes.com

nadb646e37d.headline: Capital importation dropped to $1.2bn in Q3 2024, says NBS
nadb646e37d.summary: The National Bureau of Statistics says Nigeria recorded $1.25 billion in capital importation in the third quarter of 2024. The figure marks a decline in foreign capital inflows.
nadb646e37d.why: Capital importation measures foreign investment flowing into an economy, a key indicator for currency stability and investor confidence in Nigeria.

na975215936.headline: Chilean salmon has a challenge: claw back growth in the US
na975215936.summary: Chilean salmon faces challenges in regaining growth in the US market. Post-pandemic inflation and reduced consumer spending have weighed on demand.
na975215936.why: Chile is one of the world's largest salmon farmers, so US demand conditions directly affect export revenue and the sector's profitability.

nc0652b0771.headline: Ministers accused of ‘forgetting’ students in row over Budget education funding
nc0652b0771.summary: Finance Secretary Shona Robison said investment in higher education will rise, but colleges and universities complained of cuts. The dispute centres on the Scottish Budget.
nc0652b0771.why: Scottish Budget allocations determine public spending on education and shape funding conditions for universities and colleges.

n17397ecef0.headline: Consolidated Bank Ghana resumes foreign exchange transactions after BOG suspension
n17397ecef0.summary: Consolidated Bank Ghana resumed foreign exchange transactions at all branches from December 4, 2024. The move followed the Bank of Ghana restoring its foreign currency trading licence.
n17397ecef0.why: Foreign exchange licences allow banks to trade foreign currency, which matters for importers, exporters and investors dealing with the cedi in Ghana's financial system.

n1641a21453.headline: More loans, more pains and the season of discontent
n1641a21453.summary: Nigeria's National Assembly has approved $2.2 billion in external borrowing for the Tinubu administration to help address the fiscal deficit in the 2024 budget.
n1641a21453.why: External borrowing affects Nigeria's debt burden, fiscal sustainability and sovereign credit profile, which matter to investors in Nigerian government bonds and the naira.

n8b8b58f627.headline: Thames Water: Bidders line up for struggling utility giant
n8b8b58f627.summary: Thames Water, the UK's largest water company, has received multiple bids as it faces running out of money next year.
n8b8b58f627.why: Thames Water is Britain's largest water utility, and its financing and possible sale involve large debt holders, regulators and water-sector investors.

nadf3724583.headline: Bank of Ghana lifts CBG forex ban
nadf3724583.summary: Consolidated Bank Ghana can resume foreign exchange trading after the Bank of Ghana lifted a temporary suspension of its forex trading licence. The suspension had been due to regulatory non-compliance issues.
nadf3724583.why: Forex trading licences allow banks to deal in foreign currency, which is important for customers and for market liquidity. Central bank supervision of lenders affects confidence in the banking sector.

n4534eeb287.headline: Centre gears up to make hallmarking mandatory for gold bullion
n4534eeb287.summary: The Indian government is gearing up to make hallmarking mandatory for gold bullion. The move is aimed at standardising gold quality and purity, according to the report.
n4534eeb287.why: Hallmarking certifies gold purity, and rules on it affect bullion dealers, jewellers and the gold trade in India, one of the world's largest gold markets.

n9060a31f38.headline: Reserve Bank of India cuts GDP growth estimate for FY 2024-’25 to 6.6%
n9060a31f38.summary: The Reserve Bank of India lowered its GDP growth estimate for fiscal 2024-25 to 6.6%. It also raised its inflation outlook for the year to 4.8%, up from 4.5% in October.
n9060a31f38.why: The Reserve Bank of India is the country's central bank, and its growth and inflation projections guide monetary policy and investor expectations for India's economy.

n5583c00a27.headline: Aviva Reaches Initial £3.6 Billion Deal to Buy Direct Line
n5583c00a27.summary: Aviva reached a preliminary agreement to buy Direct Line Insurance Group for £3.6 billion, or $4.6 billion. The deal would create one of the UK's largest insurers.
n5583c00a27.why: Aviva is a major UK insurer, and acquisitions in the sector can reshape market share and capital allocation for listed insurers.

n04619358f0.headline: Bad news for Perth home buyers
n04619358f0.summary: PropTrack data shows Perth dwelling values have risen 79% since March 2020. CoreLogic data shows Perth continues to lead the nation, with values up 0.8% over the recent period.
n04619358f0.why: Housing prices affect household wealth, mortgage risk and the outlook for interest rates and consumer spending.

nc9cc6f771f.headline: Bill offering wildfire survivors relief from taxes and fees passes Congress
nc9cc6f771f.summary: A bill relieving wildfire survivors across the West of federal income tax on their recovery settlements and lawyers' fees has passed Congress. Some survivors have waited more than five years for relief.
nc9cc6f771f.why: Congress sets federal tax law, and changes to tax treatment of disaster settlements affect household finances and the scope of federal disaster policy.

nf68c161165.headline: Reserve Bank forecasts house price boom after bust
nf68c161165.summary: CoreLogic data show New Zealand home values fell 0.4% nationally in November, the ninth consecutive monthly decline. The Reserve Bank had raised the official cash rate to a peak of 5.50%.
nf68c161165.why: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand sets the official cash rate, and its policy stance strongly influences mortgage costs and house prices in the country.

nf0ed408d6b.headline: Trump taps former Sen. David Perdue as ambassador to China amid tense trade relations
nf0ed408d6b.summary: Trump has tapped former Senator David Perdue as ambassador to China. In a social media post, Trump said Perdue brings expertise to help build the relationship with China.
nf0ed408d6b.why: The US ambassador to China is a key channel in bilateral relations, which shape tariffs, export controls and trade flows between the two largest economies.

n0bff2e7f2b.headline: House price rises to continue into 2025, says Halifax
n0bff2e7f2b.summary: Halifax said UK house prices are expected to keep rising into 2025. The average house price reached £298,083 last month.
n0bff2e7f2b.why: Halifax is a major UK mortgage lender, and its house price index is a closely watched gauge of the housing market. Housing trends affect mortgage lending and bank balance sheets.

n266e9ffee2.headline: Oilfield services provider Flowco shows revenue surge in US IPO filing
n266e9ffee2.summary: Oilfield services provider Flowco showed a surge in revenue in paperwork filed Friday for a U.S. initial public offering, amid a revival in investor interest.
n266e9ffee2.why: Oilfield services firms supply drilling and well-maintenance work to oil and gas producers, so their results track upstream energy spending.

na45220737a.headline: Trump names former Sen. David Perdue of Georgia to be ambassador to China
na45220737a.summary: President Trump named former Georgia Senator David Perdue, a former business executive turned politician, as envoy to China, the US's most potent economic and military adversary.
na45220737a.why: The US ambassador to China is the administration's main diplomatic channel on trade, tariffs and tech restrictions with the world's second-largest economy.

n8871e8da92.headline: Leader of Yoon's party calls for president's suspension, citing 'great danger' to country
n8871e8da92.summary: The leader of South Korea's ruling party called for the swift suspension of President Yoon Suk Yeol, citing the "great risk" of another martial law attempt. The call adds to the country's political turmoil.
n8871e8da92.why: South Korea is Asia's fourth-largest economy, and political instability can affect investor confidence in its equities, bonds and the won.

n45e1693887.headline: China fine tunes economic stimulus as it braces for new US administration
n45e1693887.summary: China is fine-tuning policies aimed at reviving its economy as it braces for an uncertain future in relations with the United States. The adjustments come ahead of the incoming Trump administration.
n45e1693887.why: China's stimulus policies affect global commodity demand, trade flows and the outlook for Chinese equities and the yuan.

ne20903d877.headline: Risk-wary markets count down to payrolls
ne20903d877.summary: Risk sentiment weakened in Asia on Friday after renewed political rumblings in South Korea, and investors are awaiting the US payrolls report.
ne20903d877.why: The US jobs report is a key gauge of labour market strength that influences Federal Reserve rate expectations and global asset prices.
ne20903d877.why_moved: Risk appetite fell in Asian trading after renewed political concerns in South Korea, and markets are cautious ahead of the payrolls release.

n094722c383.headline: Alberta cleans up 5% of inactive wells in 2023
n094722c383.summary: The number of inactive oil and gas wells in Alberta fell 5% in 2023 to 79,000 from 83,000, a regulatory report said. Decommissioning and reclamation work is progressing.
n094722c383.why: Alberta is Canada's main oil-producing province, and well decommissioning costs affect the liabilities of producers operating there.

n93d8886a7c.headline: General Motors takes multi-billion dollar hit as China troubles mount
n93d8886a7c.summary: General Motors is taking a multibillion-dollar hit as tougher competition from domestic Chinese brands erodes what was once a profit centre for the company.
n93d8886a7c.why: General Motors is a major US automaker, and its China joint ventures have historically been a significant source of earnings.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: A multibillion-dollar charge in China directly weighs on the company's reported profits.

ne3f048cbc3.headline: GLOBAL MARKETS-Wall Street adds to stock, rate cut bets after 'Thanksgiving buffet' jobs data | Business
ne3f048cbc3.summary: Investors raised bets on a US interest rate cut this month after November payrolls showed job growth roughly in line with expectations. The euro dipped against the dollar as political turmoil gripped France.
ne3f048cbc3.why: US payrolls data guide Federal Reserve policy expectations, which influence Treasury yields, equity valuations and the dollar.
ne3f048cbc3.why_moved: Payroll growth came in roughly in line with expectations, raising bets on a Federal Reserve rate cut this month. Investors also reacted to French political turmoil weighing on the euro.

n1a7f7c85f3.headline: S. Arabia rolls over $3bn deposit for another year
n1a7f7c85f3.summary: Saudi Arabia has rolled over a $3 billion deposit for another year. SBP-held forex reserves have risen by half since the beginning of 2024.
n1a7f7c85f3.why: The State Bank of Pakistan holds the country's foreign exchange reserves, which support its ability to pay for imports and debt service.

n6b513b6178.headline: Resorts World Las Vegas announces board members, CEO
n6b513b6178.summary: Genting Bhd's indirect subsidiary Resorts World Las Vegas has formed a board of directors that assumed roles on December 4, 2024. Jim Murren was named chairman.
n6b513b6178.why: Resorts World Las Vegas is an integrated casino resort owned by Malaysia's Genting group, and its governance affects the parent company's US gaming exposure.

nd9867633fb.headline: Unending bull run tosses index above 108,000
nd9867633fb.summary: Bulls extended a record-setting streak on the Karachi Stock Exchange, tightening their grip as the KSE-100 index climbed above 108,000 points.
nd9867633fb.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange in Karachi, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
nd9867633fb.why_moved: The article describes a continued record-setting rally led by bulls on the Karachi market; it gives no specific cause.

n51266708ba.headline: Nepra allows 20 paise per unit hike for December
n51266708ba.summary: Pakistan's electricity regulator Nepra allowed a 20 paise per unit hike for December, while claiming the tariff would still be Rs1.54 per unit cheaper than the existing rate.
n51266708ba.why: Nepra is Pakistan's National Electric Power Regulatory Authority, which sets electricity tariffs that affect household costs and utility finances.

n560dac773a.headline: Japan's revised Q3 GDP likely to show slow recovery in test of BOJ's optimism
n560dac773a.summary: A Reuters poll suggests Japan's economy expanded in the third quarter at the same moderate pace first reported. A consumption bump may prove temporary.
n560dac773a.why: Japan's GDP trends shape Bank of Japan policy, including its path for interest rates and yen-related decisions.

n5a08e344ea.headline: Slippages to be covered, new IMF representative assured
n5a08e344ea.summary: Pakistan has assured the IMF that slippages will be covered, according to Dawn. The first biannual review of the $7bn programme is due in February.
n5a08e344ea.why: The IMF programme provides financing support to Pakistan and its conditions shape the country's fiscal and external stability.

n9d3a411486.headline: Year-ender 2024: Over 300 passive mutual funds offer up to 51% return in 2024
n9d3a411486.summary: More than 300 passive mutual funds in India delivered returns of up to 51% in 2024. Mirae Asset NYSE FANG+ ETF led at 50.90%, while private banks and FMCG lagged.
n9d3a411486.why: Passive funds track market indices and are a growing share of retail investing in India's equity markets.

neefc85d938.headline: PM Shehbaz seeks steps to boost exports
neefc85d938.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif ordered steps to increase rice exports. He was informed of economic interest expressed by Tajikistan and Russia.
neefc85d938.why: Rice exports are a source of foreign-exchange earnings for Pakistan, affecting its trade balance.

n5e8509f26e.headline: The Week in Oil :  Supply Concerns Persist Despite OPEC+ Cut Extensions
n5e8509f26e.summary: Oil prices are heading for modest weekly losses, with supply concerns persisting despite OPEC+ extending its output cuts.
n5e8509f26e.why: OPEC+ is a group of oil producers whose output decisions strongly influence global crude supply and prices.

nec683688d0.headline: Central banks hitting pause could ‘spoil the party’
nec683688d0.summary: New Zealand equities take a back seat this week as the market emerges from reporting season, with central banks pausing rate moves.
nec683688d0.why: The NZX 50 is New Zealand's benchmark index, and central-bank rate paths affect equity valuations and borrowing costs.

source.name: NBR | Business news & analysis | Independent, ad-free reporting

n36cfa7d886.headline: Canada Jobless Rate Jumps to 6.8% in November Despite Strong Hiring -- 2nd Update
n36cfa7d886.summary: Canada's jobless rate rose to 6.8% in November, its highest since the worst of the pandemic lockdowns, even though hiring was the strongest in seven months.
n36cfa7d886.why: Statistics Canada's monthly Labour Force Survey is a key gauge of Canada's economic health and influences Bank of Canada rate expectations.
n36cfa7d886.why_moved: A higher-than-expected jobless rate despite job gains points to a loosening labour market, which can shift expectations for Bank of Canada interest-rate decisions.

nc9b5e957e7.headline: Toronto Stocks Rise, BRP Shares Up on Guidance
nc9b5e957e7.summary: Toronto stocks were modestly higher, led by tech stocks, while BRP shares rose on its guidance.
nc9b5e957e7.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, and BRP is a Quebec-based maker of recreational vehicles listed in Toronto.

n56ce29af46.headline: ICE Canola Uptrend Continues on Smaller Crop, Soyoil Support
n56ce29af46.summary: ICE Futures canola prices were stronger at midday Friday for a second day as tightening supply projections remained supportive, with Statistics Canada pegging the 2024/25 crop lower.
n56ce29af46.why: Canola is a major Canadian oilseed crop, and ICE canola futures in Winnipeg are the benchmark for its price.

nba1fac3c6f.headline: Recession fatigued Aussies refuse to spend tax cuts
nba1fac3c6f.summary: Australian Bureau of Statistics national accounts showed real per capita household spending fell 0.6% over the quarter, down 2.0% annually. Households appeared to bank rather than spend Stage 3 tax cuts.
nba1fac3c6f.why: Household consumption makes up the largest share of Australia's GDP, so spending trends shape the outlook for growth, interest rates and consumer-facing companies.

n1505956561.headline: FAO: World Food Prices Rose Again
n1505956561.summary: The Food and Agriculture Organization announced that world food prices increased for the fourth month in a row in November, reaching the highest level since April 2023.
n1505956561.why: Rising global food prices impact inflation, consumer costs, and economic stability, especially in import-dependent countries.
n1505956561.why_moved: The continued rise in food prices signals supply constraints or demand pressures, affecting inflation expectations and commodity markets.
